svg.title: The label service's Azure pipeline
svg.desc: The label service's Azure pipeline: 7 nodes, 7 connections. 6 jobs in 3 stages, 2 of which deploy to an environment, in the order dependsOn sets. A dashed arrow reaches a job that runs only when its condition holds. Imported from Azure Pipelines. Nodes: - Pipeline starts, terminal - CI and CD: Build and test - Unit tests (2 matrix runs, ubuntu-24.04, 3 steps), step - Synthesize the cloud assembly (ubuntu-24.04, 4 steps), step - Licence and vulnerability audit (when its condition holds, ubuntu-24.04, 1 step), step - CI and CD: Deploy to staging - cdk deploy (when its condition holds, deploys to labels-staging, ubuntu-24.04, 2 steps), step - Print a test label (when its condition holds, ubuntu-24.04, 1 step), step - CI and CD: Deploy to production - cdk deploy (deploys to labels-production, ubuntu-24.04, 3 steps), step Connections: - Unit tests to Synthesize the cloud assembly - Pipeline starts to Unit tests - Pipeline starts to Licence and vulnerability audit (dashed) - cdk deploy to Print a test label (dashed) - Synthesize the cloud assembly to cdk deploy (dashed) - Licence and vulnerability audit to cdk deploy (dashed) - Print a test label to cdk deploy
